leadText:
Iolite (Japanese: アイオライト Aioraito) is the Japanese opening theme for the Rising Again arc and the sixth of Pokémon Horizons: The Series. It debuted in HZ115, replacing GET BACK.

The full version of the song was released as a digital single on October 31, 2025, with the music video being released on November 1, 2025.
plainText:
Iolite (Japanese: アイオライト Aioraito) is the Japanese opening theme for the Rising Again arc and the sixth of Pokémon Horizons: The Series. It debuted in HZ115, replacing GET BACK.

The full version of the song was released as a digital single on October 31, 2025, with the music video being released on November 1, 2025.

==Opening animation==
===Synopsis===
A lone star in the sky shines greatly before being covered by a flurry of clouds that act as a transition to the Brave Olivine flying in the sky. At the back of the ship, the sun shines on Liko, Roy, Dot, and Ult with their respective partners and Captain Pikachu. On beat with the music, a still image of each member of the Rising Volt Tacklers and their party is shown, starting with Liko and ending with Friede. Afterward, the series logo appears in front of a comet shooting across space. It then zooms out of Pagogo's eye as Liko holds it while standing in a field with , , and . Liko, Meowscarada, Roy, , Dot, , Ult, and jump together.

Friede's Mega Evolved appears before joining its and on a path in space. Roy's Lucario exchanges blows Master Mayonnaise's . At sunset, Amethio trains and while Zirc, Onia, and their Pokémon watch. He then briefly turns to the camera before looking up, changing the focus to the White Zygarde. Liko and Armarouge walk together as she steps on a puddle. Roy, Ult, Lucario, and Sableye sit together, watching the cloudy sky. Dot and stand together as gust of wind blows her hair while the sun comes out. While the sky changes according to the time of day, a series of overlays appear – an Auspicious Armor, two hands with Mega Rings exchanging fist bumps, Nidothing's ears, someone holding a Gimmighoul Coin, a bunch of mochi filling the screen, someone holding a Strong Sphere, a cluster of Laquium crystals, a silhouette of Indi and Rubina in front of the Explorers logo, and finally the Black Rayquaza looking up and gazing straight at the camera. Another series of still images appear, this time featuring the allies of the Rising Volt Tacklers alongside their Pokémon, followed by the Explorers and their Pokémon.

On the wing deck, at Liko's command, Meowscarada moves in to attack, followed by Armarouge and Hatterene. Roy joins in with his own command for Skeledirge, Mega Lucario, and . Dot is next, with Quaquaval, , and Gholdengo. Ult goes next with Sableye and before Cap rushes at the camera with . The camera then pans over Liko, Roy, Dot, Ult, Ann, , and Penny as it changes into all their Pokémon standing together. Spinel's and Meowscarada battle each other. The Laquium Core is shown. The eighteen Terastallized Pokémon involved in the purification of the Laquium appear one by one as they fly to the sky over Laqua, later showing as one group when the camera zooms out. Liko is clutching a before a series of flashbacks of her appears, starting with her as a young child looking to the side, then in her Indigo Academy uniform briefly turning to the front, and finally in the present day looking directly at the camera. Liko, with Dot, Ult, Quaquaval, and Sableye behind her, faces Meowscarada, with Roy, Skeledirge, and Cap behind the . The Brave Olivine then flies toward the horizon.

==Variants==
HZ115: The original animation.
HZ116 - HZ118: The animation is updated to include 's .
HZ119: The animation is updated to include Liko's Hatterene.
HZ120: The animation is updated to include Roy's Skeledirge.
HZ121: The animation is updated to include Dot's Gholdengo.
HZ122 - HZ123: The scene with Lacey is replaced by Friede (in his new clothes) running alongside and , while the scene with Drayton is replaced by battling Master Mayonnaise's . Lacey and Drayton battling is replaced by Liko's Meowscarada battling Spinel's , followed quickly by a silhouette of something unknown.
HZ124: The animation is updated to include Diana's .
HZ125: The animation is updated to include Liko's Armarouge and the White Zygarde in its .
HZ126 - HZ128: The scene with the Six Heroes is updated to show them, except for the Black Rayquaza, battling in their stallized states.
HZ129: The animation is updated to include Dot's Quaquaval.
HZ130: The scene with the Six Heroes is updated to show the Black Rayquaza battling in its Terastallized state.
HZ131 - HZ132: The animation is updated to include Hamber's and .
HZ133 - HZ136: Roy's Lucario and Master Mayonnaise's Hawlucha's battle scene is updated to show them as Mega Lucario Z and Mega Hawlucha. Liko's Meowscarada and Spinel's Umbreon battle scene is updated with the background clearly showing Laqua, with the unknown silhouette revealing itself to be the Laquium Core. The scene with the Terastallized Six Heroes is replaced by the eighteen Terastallized Pokémon involved in the purification of the Laquium flying to the sky over Laqua.

sections.text:
HZ115: The original animation.
HZ116 - HZ118: The animation is updated to include 's .
HZ119: The animation is updated to include Liko's Hatterene.
HZ120: The animation is updated to include Roy's Skeledirge.
HZ121: The animation is updated to include Dot's Gholdengo.
HZ122 - HZ123: The scene with Lacey is replaced by Friede (in his new clothes) running alongside and , while the scene with Drayton is replaced by battling Master Mayonnaise's . Lacey and Drayton battling is replaced by Liko's Meowscarada battling Spinel's , followed quickly by a silhouette of something unknown.
HZ124: The animation is updated to include Diana's .
HZ125: The animation is updated to include Liko's Armarouge and the White Zygarde in its .
HZ126 - HZ128: The scene with the Six Heroes is updated to show them, except for the Black Rayquaza, battling in their stallized states.
HZ129: The animation is updated to include Dot's Quaquaval.
HZ130: The scene with the Six Heroes is updated to show the Black Rayquaza battling in its Terastallized state.
HZ131 - HZ132: The animation is updated to include Hamber's and .
HZ133 - HZ136: Roy's Lucario and Master Mayonnaise's Hawlucha's battle scene is updated to show them as Mega Lucario Z and Mega Hawlucha. Liko's Meowscarada and Spinel's Umbreon battle scene is updated with the background clearly showing Laqua, with the unknown silhouette revealing itself to be the Laquium Core. The scene with the Terastallized Six Heroes is replaced by the eighteen Terastallized Pokémon involved in the purification of the Laquium flying to the sky over Laqua.

aiReadySummary.title: Iolite
aiReadySummary.searchableText:
Iolite
Category:Japanese opening themes
Iolite (Japanese: アイオライト Aioraito) is the Japanese opening theme for the Rising Again arc and the sixth of Pokémon Horizons: The Series. It debuted in HZ115, replacing GET BACK.

The full version of the song was released as a digital single on October 31, 2025, with the music video being released on November 1, 2025.
